create_KolorsInpaintPipeline: create a KolorsInpaintPipeline instance for text-guided image inpainting with a mask
run_pipeline_inpaint: run the KolorsInpaintPipeline to inpaint an image given a prompt, init image, and mask image
encode_prompt_text: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using the ChatGLM text encoder
prepare_mask_latents: prepare mask and masked image latents resized to match the VAE latent space dimensions
prepare_latents_noise: prepare initial latents by combining encoded image latents with noise at a given timestep
